mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.industry_code as industry_code,a.app_ver_code,b.keeper_id,b.keeper_name, a.sign_over as sign_in_time, a.sign_close as sign_out_time,a.sign_begin,a.sign_end,a.sign_in_time as bus_in_time,a.sign_out_time as bus_out_time, c.grid_id FROM bm_attendance_set a , bm_gridkeeper b LEFT JOIN bm_grid_keeper_ref c on b.keeper_id = c.keeper_id WHERE a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND a.industry_code = b.industry_code AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{weekDay},a.on_weekdays)
